title: Biallelic variants in COX18 cause a mitochondrial disorder primarily manifesting as peripheral neuropathy.

reviewer.method: Personally read all 677 main-text lines, all three original figures, every cell/footnote of both main tables with original PDF pixels, and all six pages of both PDF supplements including unedited blots. All four selected/alternate packets, six alleles and 76 phenotype items assessed individually. Clinical video held with verified extent but unread; no full-video claim. Retrieval inherited; new extraction/rendering and byte hashes verified.

audit.exposure_note: The mandatory HANDOFF.md read at session start exposed aggregate benchmark results and a historical HG002/FGFR2 public-control case-specific rank. No target-case outcome files, current assigned-cohort per-case ranks or evaluator outputs were consulted. This review is not blinded. Prior records retain their original attribution; this reviewer claims only the work specified in method.
